library.rt_080:r_4eaaa79892e5d399.text:
Another form of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, which appears when the special OS 'NT-D' installed in the unit activates.
The frame throughout its body extends, and the armor slides open at the seams, exposing the psycoframe that glows red beneath. The horn on its head also spreads open to the left and right as the unit 'transforms' into a Gundam.
In this form, the pilot's thoughts, read through the frame throughout the body, are directly reflected in the unit's movements. This system makes it possible to move the machine by thought alone. In doing so, it becomes possible to draw out the unit's performance to its limits, producing mobility that exceeds human perception.
On the other hand, the G-forces generated by its mobility and the strain on the brain from using the psycommu place a heavy burden on the pilot, and the operational limit a pilot can endure is thought to be around five minutes.

library.rt_080:r_37bb9575f68521df.text:
Another form of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, which appears when the special OS 'NT-D' installed in the unit activates.
The frame throughout its body extends, and the armor slides open at the seams, exposing the psycoframe that glows red beneath. The horn on its head also spreads open to the left and right as the unit 'transforms' into a Gundam.
In this form, the pilot's thoughts, read through the frame throughout the body, are directly reflected in the unit's movements. This system makes it possible to move the machine by thought alone. In doing so, it becomes possible to draw out the unit's performance to its limits, producing mobility that exceeds human perception.
On the other hand, the G-forces generated by its mobility and the strain on the brain from using the psycommu place a heavy burden on the pilot, and the operational limit a pilot can endure is thought to be around five minutes.
'NT-D' stands for 'Newtype Destroyer', and the system activates automatically when it detects the sensory waves of a Newtype or an Enhanced Human aboard an enemy unit.
Once this system activates, the psycommu system overrides the pilot's will, and their thinking becomes fixated solely on destroying the enemy unit.
Because of this, it is speculated that the unit may have been developed as a hunting machine intended for the extermination of Newtypes.
The unit also has a system called the 'Laplace Program' built into it by $$カーディアス・ビスト$$'s own hand, one that was not part of its original specifications. Under certain conditions, this system progressively reveals the path leading to Laplace's Box, giving the unit the role of a key to unlocking it as well.
Soon after he began piloting it, $$バナージ$$ was at the mercy of the NT-D, but as he grew, he became able to trigger Destroy Mode without being swallowed by the system.

library.rt_080:r_87cc3d7f1d05c874.text:
A mobile suit developed for the mass production of the $$Ｚガンダム$$.
Where the $$リ・ガズィ$$ substituted a BWS (Back Weapon System) for a variable mechanism, this unit simplifies matters by adopting the $$メタス$$'s variable mechanism instead.
By sharing actuators and internal electronics as much as possible, costs were reduced, and it was completed as the first variable mobile suit of the GM and $$ジェガン$$ lineage.
Its weapons and backpack can be swapped according to mission requirements; besides standard armaments such as the beam rifle and beam saber, it can also carry large-caliber weapons such as the mega beam launcher.
The only visible difference between the squad leader's unit and standard units is color: the leader's unit has green sensors, with its chest and legs in dark gray.

library.rt_080:r_bf8f7b744563fa5d.text:
The $$リゼル$$'s cruising configuration.
By converging the thrusters throughout the unit's body toward the rear, it achieves high mobility. Its weapons are mounted facing forward, so they remain usable even in this configuration.
The backpack on its rear has grips for mobile suits to hold onto, and by making use of its surplus thrust, it can also be operated as a sub flight system.

library.rt_080:r_566acff2ff34040e.text:
A variable mobile suit developed by Anaheim Electronics.
Although originally designed as a variable unit, the Hyaku Shiki was completed as a fixed-form unit due to frame strength problems; this unit reexamines that shortcoming, and was redesigned incorporating the technical strengths of the $$Ｚガンダム$$, such as the bio-sensor.
As a result, it became capable of transforming into $$ウェイブ・ライダー$$ mode, and was completed as an all-purpose attack unit with flight capability under gravity and atmospheric reentry capability, able to operate in every domain.
However, due to the cost problems common to variable units, and to the many non-standard parts used in its construction, it never reached mass production, and only a small number were built.
Because these characteristics make it difficult to incorporate into standard unit formations, it was assigned to the similarly non-standard $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, where $$リディ・マーセナス$$ served as its pilot.

library.rt_080:r_c7d16d0dc93c780b.text:
The $$デルタプラス$$'s $$ウェイブ・ライダー$$ configuration.
Capable of independent atmospheric reentry and flight under gravity.
It was designed with the aim of further developing the $$Ｚガンダム$$'s variable functionality, and improves its aerial combat performance through features such as the flexible binders that serve as variable wings, and thrusters concentrated toward the rear.
The part used as a shield in mobile suit mode becomes the nose cone in this configuration, with sensors, a beam cannon, grenades, and other weapons mounted at its tip.

library.rt_080:r_77b55be7b810a172.text:
A mobile suit used by the Earth Federation Forces special unit 'ECOAS.'
For a mobile suit of this era of the $$宇宙世紀$$, it is quite small, and features a mechanism allowing it to transform into a tank configuration.
It was developed as a mobile suit for responding to sporadic terrorist acts by Neo Zeon remnants and others, with an emphasis on rapid transport of troops in urban warfare and on anti-personnel suppression.
It is also equipped with various sensors and communication equipment so that it can be operated on-site as an operational command post.
It was developed by the Strategic Naval Research Institute (S.N.R.I.), and the operational data gathered from it also influenced the later development of small mobile suits.

library.rt_080:r_9a7a6796ef8e2728.text:
A successor to the Argama-class, built during the First Neo Zeon War.
Its name means 'one close to the Argama.'
During the First Neo Zeon War, it carried cutting-edge units led by the ZZ Gundam, becoming a major force in bringing the conflict to an end.
After the war ended, it underwent a large-scale refit, expanding the volume of its catapult block and modernizing its armaments.
It belongs to the Londo Bell fleet, but its lack of compatibility from having no sister ships, along with performance characteristics unsuited to fleet formations, mean it is mainly operated alone on special missions.

library.rt_080:r_bee73f3f5b449f0c.text:
A mobile suit exclusive to $$フル・フロンタル$$.
The Sleeves seized a prototype mobile suit under development by Anaheim Electronics, and operate it after applying their own modifications and decoration.
It is an experimental unit using a psycoframe in its movable frame, and the data obtained from it also proved useful in the development of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$.
It is said that the unit's ultimate performance was tested without the design even assuming a human pilot would board it, and thanks to the responsiveness afforded by the psycoframe and the mobility gained from its two pairs of flexible thrusters, reminiscent of wings, it boasts overwhelming combat power.
Its speed and crimson coloring bring to mind the 'Red Comet' in the eyes of those who see it.

library.rt_080:r_c26f97c0f5b3253c.text:
A Newtype-exclusive mobile suit owned by the Sleeves.
It was designed near the end of the First Neo Zeon War with the aim of miniaturizing the 40m-class mobile suit Quin Mantha.
It adopts a psycommu system made compact through the introduction of a psycoframe. By consolidating the funnel container that had been the cause of the Quin Mantha's large size, along with internal weapons, the main thrusters, propellant tanks, and other various functions into its four binders, it succeeded in downsizing while maintaining performance equal to the Quin Mantha.
Its performance is high, and combined with the skill of its pilot $$マリーダ$$, when it fought at Industrial 7 it single-handedly shot down much of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s mobile suit force.
However, the Sleeves lack the resources to mass-produce this unit, and cannot even fully repair its damaged sections, leaving it effectively a one-off machine.

library.rt_080:r_fc556d148e559489.text:
A Newtype-exclusive mobile suit owned by the Sleeves.
It was designed near the end of the First Neo Zeon War with the aim of miniaturizing the 40m-class mobile suit Quin Mantha.
It adopts a psycommu system made compact through the introduction of a psycoframe. By consolidating the funnel container that had been the cause of the Quin Mantha's large size, along with internal weapons, the main thrusters, propellant tanks, and other various functions into its four binders, it succeeded in downsizing while maintaining performance equal to the Quin Mantha.
Its performance is high, and combined with the skill of its pilot $$マリーダ$$, when it fought at Industrial 7 it single-handedly shot down much of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s mobile suit force.
However, the Sleeves lack the resources to mass-produce this unit, and cannot even fully repair its damaged sections, leaving it effectively a one-off machine.
It was shot down in battle against the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$'s Destroy Mode, and recovered by the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.

library.rt_080:r_30554622a06d59c5.text:
The Sleeves' main mobile suit, developed by Anaheim Electronics based on the $$ギラ・ドーガ$$.
With its green coloring and mono-eye, it follows the line of previous Zeon-derived main mobile suits, and features a gas-mask-like structure around its mouth. Its arms bear the decoration that gave rise to the name 'the Sleeves.'
Its overall performance is improved over the $$ギラ・ドーガ$$, but the unit's greatest strength lies in its versatility. It has an abundance of variations, and can be equipped for various operations by swapping equipment according to the situation.
Because of this, to the Sleeves, whose scale amounts to no more than what would be classified as a terrorist organization, this unit holds value beyond simply being a powerful mobile suit.

library.rt_080:r_a4bad97325a13c41.text:
A variant of the $$ギラ・ズール$$ piloted by $$フロンタル$$'s honor guard.
Due to the need to coordinate closely with $$フル・フロンタル$$, its output has been increased compared to the standard $$ギラ・ズール$$.
In addition, both shoulders have been changed to spikes, and the decorations applied to each part have become more elaborate.

library.rt_080:r_bf5929468c4d7c95.text:
The $$ギラ・ズール$$ piloted by $$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$.
It is painted in his personal color, purple.
Like the other honor guard units, its output has been increased, both shoulders have been changed to spikes, and the decorations applied to each part have become more elaborate.
Its equipment is changed according to the mission, using either the long-range beam weapon Runge Bruno Cannon Kai or the beam shot rifle.

library.rt_080:r_aa87cbd93b628223.text:
A mobile suit independently developed by the Zeon remnant Delaz Fleet.
It is closer to a modification than to fresh development, a stopgap unit assembled by diverting parts from $$一年戦争$$-era weapons.
However, its mobility in outer space is high, and it was judged that it could serve as a fighting force in certain situations, so a certain number were produced.
The unit the Sleeves deployed at Palau is presumed to be one that survived from that era, but repairs and modifications have been made to various parts, including its coloring and equipment.

library.rt_080:r_486d6dd3449e1a6d.text:
A mobile suit developed by Neo Zeon forces during the First Neo Zeon War for the Earth invasion operation.
It boasts stable, high performance, and its Gundarium alloy armor and high-output generator are not inferior even compared to mobile suits of the U.C. 0096 era. Because of this, it is a valuable asset to the resource-poor Sleeves.
As built-in weapons, it carries a triple-tube beam gun and a launchable slashing weapon called the Tri-Blade on its arms. It can also be equipped with the Giant Bazooka, newly developed based on the $$シナンジュ$$'s bazooka, as an option.

library.rt_080:r_1e33411f441fd9b0.text:
A derivative of the Gallus-J, developed by Neo Zeon forces during the First Neo Zeon War for ground invasion use.
Fixed weapons such as the finger missiles and shoulder missiles have been omitted, replaced with the Ga-Zowmine's hyper knuckle buster mounted on the shoulder.
Both arms are fitted with multi-purpose hardpoints; the unit that attacked Torrington Base had a Zaku Cannon's big gun mounted on its right arm and a triple missile pod on its left.

library.rt_080:r_8725681dfb9a802b.text:
The final production specification of the Dom, developed by the Principality of Zeon during the final stages of the $$一年戦争$$.
With enlarged rear thrusters and thrusters installed inside its skirt, it has nearly twice the thrust of the Dom.
It was deployed mainly around Africa and West Asia, and surviving units continued to be operated with modifications by Zeon remnant forces; records show it was used by the Blue Team and the African Liberation Front during the First Neo Zeon War as well.
Its participation from the West Asia region was also confirmed during the raid on Torrington Base.

library.rt_080:r_11b3e6618f6a5a19.text:
The favored unit of Yonmu $$カークス$$, leader of the Zeon remnant forces.
To make use of the now-obsolete Zaku I, a sub-generator was installed in an enlarged backpack, making it possible to use a beam sniper rifle.
Its head sensor has also been replaced with the head unit from the Zaku heavy-assault recon type, and it employs a method combining sniper and commander, directing operations from the rear while sniping.
During the raid on Torrington Base, the unit was fixed to the cargo hold of a modified Fat Uncle, sniping from the air while issuing orders to the units on the front line.

library.rt_080:r_6dffc48d8d0db88c.text:
A mobile suit said to have been developed by the Principality of Zeon for the assault on Jaburo during the $$一年戦争$$.
Equipped with a triple-tube rocket launcher on each arm and four beam cannons on its chest, it was developed with fire support as its concept.
It is also an extremely sturdy unit; when it struck an enemy mobile suit with its arm-mounted rocket launcher, the impact was enough to crush the opponent's armor.

library.rt_080:r_33d3b382021a1721.text:
An amphibious mobile suit developed by the Principality of Zeon.
It adopts both water-cooling and air-cooling systems, delivering high performance in both underwater and land engagements. Its mono-eye also rotates a full 360 degrees, leaving no blind spots in its field of view.
Its arms are equipped with mega particle cannons and claws, so melee combat is also anticipated.
As the completed form of the amphibious mobile suit line, derivative units were also developed.
During the $$一年戦争$$ it was finished in a blue-based coloring, but the units of the Zeon remnant forces that cooperated with the Sleeves were painted in green tones.

library.rt_080:r_827e334dda22618c.text:
A technical test unit modified from the Byarlant, a mobile suit owned by the $$ティターンズ$$ during the Gryps War.
It has been modified with an emphasis on extending flight time within the atmosphere, with reinforced thrusters throughout and additional propellant tanks.
Its small arm-mounted claws have also been enlarged by replacing them with the Gaplant's claw arms, improving its melee capabilities as well.
Its combat power is high; in the battle at Torrington Base, it destroyed Zeon remnant mobile suits one after another.

library.rt_080:r_9d0fbd1535ca6982.text:
An amphibious mobile armor completed by Zeon remnant forces over the course of six years, based on design data left over from the First Neo Zeon War.
With a large mega particle cannon as its main armament, and diffusion mega particle cannons and reflector bits as secondary armament, it is capable of attacks with no blind spots. Its enormous, multi-jointed arms also boast tremendous power, capable even of piercing a carrier's deck from beneath its hull.
Its development received financial and technical support from the Sleeves, and a psycoframe is mounted around its cockpit, making it possible for a single pilot to handle its complex controls and weapons systems.
When submerged, it combines the electromagnetically induced direct hydrodynamic propulsion units mounted on its shoulders with Minovsky Craft technology, achieving both high mobility and quiet operation.

library.rt_080:r_ca0827382889c7eb.text:
An amphibious mobile armor completed by Zeon remnant forces over the course of six years, based on design data left over from the First Neo Zeon War.
With a large mega particle cannon as its main armament, and diffusion mega particle cannons and reflector bits as secondary armament, it is capable of attacks with no blind spots. Its enormous, multi-jointed arms also boast tremendous power, capable even of piercing a carrier's deck from beneath its hull.
Its development received financial and technical support from the Sleeves, and a psycoframe is mounted around its cockpit, making it possible for a single pilot to handle its complex controls and weapons systems.
When submerged, it combines the electromagnetically induced direct hydrodynamic propulsion units mounted on its shoulders with Minovsky Craft technology, achieving both high mobility and quiet operation.
However, control of the psycommu places a heavy burden on the pilot, and during the battle at Torrington Base, it overrode the will of its pilot $$ロニ$$, triggering a rampage.

library.rt_080:r_d45c2bc6669a87e3.text:
A space cargo ship operated by the Sleeves, disguised as a civilian freighter.
It can carry up to four mobile suits, and has atmospheric reentry capability and flight capability under gravity.
As it is normally operated as a shuttle transport vessel, it carries no weapons to speak of, aside from rockets for destroying debris.
Its hull bears the disguise markings 'Ribacona Cargo.'
It made port at Industrial 7 under orders to receive Laplace's Box.

library.rt_080:r_2b95ba2f81818f87.text:
A space cargo ship operated by the Sleeves, disguised as a civilian freighter.
It can carry up to four mobile suits, and has atmospheric reentry capability and flight capability under gravity.
As it is normally operated as a shuttle transport vessel, it originally carried no weapons to speak of beyond rockets for destroying debris, but it was later fitted with the Squale Cannon, developed in the final stages of the $$一年戦争$$.
Its hull bears the disguise markings 'Ribacona Cargo.'
It made port at Industrial 7 under orders to receive Laplace's Box.

library.rt_080:r_691105b85983875e.text:
A faster-than-light all-purpose large transforming and combining machine weapon, developed by Kouichirou Ohta by gathering the pinnacle of fourth-generation FTL large spacecraft technology.
It is completed when Buster Machine No. 1 and No. 2 combine.
Developed to overturn the balance of power against the Space Monsters, this unit possesses a bulk that defies the common sense of other machine weapons, along with the tremendous power produced by its two degeneration reactors.
Making use of that power, it has numerous weapons of extraordinary force built into it, including the minus-100-million-degree freeze ray 'Buster Beam' and the 'Double Buster Corrider,' which fires a current of 1 billion gigavolts.
When it was first operated in complete form at the Absolute Defense Line of Planet Raoh, it fought alone against countless Space Monsters and overwhelmed them, living up fully to its design concept.
However, drawing out its performance to the fullest requires excellent piloting skill, and so its pilot is required to have a corresponding amount of 'effort' and 'guts.'

library.rt_080:r_e775c0f21ae662c4.text:
A faster-than-light all-purpose large transforming and combining machine weapon, developed by Kouichirou Ohta by gathering the pinnacle of fourth-generation FTL large spacecraft technology.
It is completed when Buster Machine No. 1 and No. 2 combine.
Developed to overturn the balance of power against the Space Monsters, this unit possesses a bulk that defies the common sense of other machine weapons, along with the tremendous power produced by its two degeneration reactors.
Making use of that power, it has numerous weapons of extraordinary force built into it, including the minus-100-million-degree freeze ray 'Buster Beam' and the 'Double Buster Corrider,' which fires a current of 1 billion gigavolts.
When it was first operated in complete form at the Absolute Defense Line of Planet Raoh, it fought alone against countless Space Monsters and overwhelmed them, living up fully to its design concept.
However, drawing out its performance to the fullest requires excellent piloting skill, and so its pilot is required to have a corresponding amount of 'effort' and 'guts.'
In the final battle, in order to detonate Buster Machine No. 3, it self-destructed one of its degeneration reactors, leading the Carnedes Plan to success, but the unit itself was caught up in the resulting black hole and sent far away through time.

library.rt_080:r_a900b7fc5fe27158.text:
The smallest of the Space Monsters, of the 10m class. Its official scientific name is 'Babolar.'
It parasitizes inside a Landing Craft, and is released to fight after the Landing Craft carries out its assault.
Its numbers are the greatest of any type, but it possesses neither reproductive nor digestive organs, and dies out two to three hours after being released.

library.rt_080:r_23a4332fb30bf95d.text:
A cone-shaped Space Monster. Its interior houses a large number of soldiers.
It normally clings like a thorn to the surface of a Cruiser-class, but upon spotting an enemy, it detaches from the Cruiser-class and charges forward at high acceleration. The instant it pierces its target, it releases the soldiers within to overwhelm it; this is its method of attack.
Multi-stage boosters are fitted to its rear, increasing the force of its charge.

library.rt_080:r_394dd3fb5ba509b7.text:
The individuals that form the core of the Space Monsters.
Individuals of this size are capable of independent warp.
They can move at near-light speed, and are equipped with light spheres and giant fireballs capable of sinking even a space battleship in a single blow, making them a threat even alone. In addition to this, they attack while releasing large numbers of soldiers.
Among individuals of this size, the type known as the high-speed type is somewhat smaller than other individuals of the same class and inferior in firepower, but boasts high mobility. A large-capacity cooling organ that trails in the ether current is attached to its rear.

library.rt_080:r_8605552e970d231c.text:
The fighter mode of a unit that $$バサラ$$ remodeled to his own preferred design from the VF-19C, which was developed under the military's 'Project M,' a program researching Song Energy. Commonly known as the Fire Valkyrie.
It is equipped with a special piloting system called the Sound Stick System, and is controlled using a control stick shaped like a guitar.
Its performance is close to that of the prototype YF-19, rivaling the military's standard-issue units, and combined with $$バサラ$$'s genius technique, it flew freely across the battlefield in every direction.

library.rt_080:r_3ee26d16dc9ec419.text:
The fighter mode of a variable fighter officially adopted by the $$マクロス７$$ fleet.
It is based on the YF-21, which once competed against the YF-19.
The brainwave control system that was the YF-21's greatest feature has been removed, replaced with a cockpit supporting visual flight and manual control. These changes achieved a major reduction in cost and a lighter airframe.
Thanks to its lighter weight and main wings capable of changing shape, it possesses mobility rivaling that of the prototype YF-21.
$$ガムリン$$ used this unit to pursue $$バサラ$$ to the planet Zola, joining the battle between the Zola garrison's Galaxy Patrol and the Galaxy Whale poaching fleet.

library.rt_080:r_6dc0517256919025.text:
The Battroid mode of a variable fighter officially adopted by the $$マクロス７$$ fleet.
It is based on the YF-21, which once competed against the YF-19.
The brainwave control system that was the YF-21's greatest feature has been removed, replaced with a cockpit supporting visual flight and manual control. These changes achieved a major reduction in cost and a lighter airframe.
Zentraedi technology has also been applied, and like the prototype YF-21, its design resembles that of a Battle Suit.
$$ガムリン$$ used this unit to pursue $$バサラ$$ to the planet Zola, joining the battle between the Zola garrison's Galaxy Patrol and the Galaxy Whale poaching fleet.

library.rt_080:r_66b0c26f80c15f92.text:
A vanguard unit of the VF-25 Messiah series. Its Fighter mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, atmospheric-use specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
The VF-25 Messiah is the latest multirole variable fighter, a unit jointly developed by the private companies L.A.I. and Shinsei Industry based on the YF-24, a prototype developed by the New United Nations Spacy. It is operated by $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ in the form of evaluation testing prior to official military deployment.
The Tornado Pack is a state-of-the-art reinforcement pack that adds equipment such as a rotary twin beam gun and rotary engine pods to the VF-25. Equipping this pack not only increases firepower, but also greatly improves mobility and maneuverability.
Normally, rotating the twin beam gun's long barrel within the atmosphere would cause aerodynamic problems, but these are resolved by using the movable engine pods to compensate for changes in airflow.
Thanks to these engine pods, the Tornado Pack grants the VF-25 even higher aerial combat mobility than when equipped with the Super Pack.

library.rt_080:r_a99ffc4d49bfccbc.text:
A vanguard unit of the VF-25 Messiah series. Its Battroid mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, atmospheric-use specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
The VF-25 Messiah is the latest multirole variable fighter, a unit jointly developed by the private companies L.A.I. and Shinsei Industry based on the YF-24, a prototype developed by the New United Nations Spacy. It is operated by $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ in the form of evaluation testing prior to official military deployment.
The Tornado Pack is a state-of-the-art reinforcement pack that adds equipment such as a rotary twin beam gun and rotary engine pods to the VF-25. Equipping this pack not only increases firepower, but also greatly improves mobility and maneuverability.
Its main armaments include, in addition to the twin beam gun mounted on its back, a 58mm gatling gun pod, a micro-missile launcher, an assault knife, and more.

library.rt_080:r_654e7e99337dae8c.text:
A vanguard unit of the VF-25 Messiah series. Its Fighter mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, exo-atmospheric specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
The VF-25 Messiah is the latest multirole variable fighter, a unit jointly developed by the private companies L.A.I. and Shinsei Industry based on the YF-24, a prototype developed by the New United Nations Spacy. It is operated by $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ in the form of evaluation testing prior to official military deployment.
The Tornado Pack is a state-of-the-art reinforcement pack that adds equipment such as a rotary twin beam gun and rotary engine pods to the VF-25. Equipping this pack not only increases firepower, but also greatly improves mobility and maneuverability.
In exo-atmospheric operation, a propellant auxiliary tank that doubles as an atmospheric reentry fairing is attached to the tip of the engine pods.

library.rt_080:r_74e85aa1bc237d43.text:
A vanguard unit of the VF-25 Messiah series. Its Battroid mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, exo-atmospheric specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
The VF-25 Messiah is the latest multirole variable fighter, a unit jointly developed by the private companies L.A.I. and Shinsei Industry based on the YF-24, a prototype developed by the New United Nations Spacy. It is operated by $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ in the form of evaluation testing prior to official military deployment.
The Tornado Pack is a state-of-the-art reinforcement pack that adds equipment such as a rotary twin beam gun and rotary engine pods to the VF-25. Equipping this pack not only increases firepower, but also greatly improves mobility and maneuverability.
In exo-atmospheric operation, since the atmosphere needed to cool the beam generation core and reactor cannot be obtained, the cooling unit at the rear of the twin beam unit is deployed for use.
Its main armaments include, in addition to the twin beam gun mounted on its back, a 58mm gatling gun pod, a micro-missile launcher, an assault knife, and more.

library.rt_080:r_ffe34af8825f3b34.text:
A vanguard unit of the VF-25 Messiah series. Its Battroid mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, exo-atmospheric specification.
It belongs to $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$'s Skull Squadron, with the call sign 'Skull 4.'
The VF-25 Messiah is the latest multirole variable fighter. It is a unit jointly developed by the private companies L.A.I. and Shinsei Industry based on the YF-24, a prototype developed by the New United Nations Spacy, and has been deployed to $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ in the form of trial operation.
The Tornado Pack is a state-of-the-art reinforcement pack that adds equipment such as a rotary twin beam gun and rotary engine pods to the VF-25. Equipping this pack not only increases firepower, but also greatly improves mobility and maneuverability.
When a Battroid mode equipped with this pack operates outside the atmosphere, the cooling unit at the rear of the twin beam unit is deployed like a tail. This is because the atmosphere needed to cool the beam generation core and reactor cannot be obtained. Large micro-missile pods are also mounted on the main wing units.
Its main armaments include, in addition to the twin beam gun mounted on its back, a 58mm gatling gun pod, a micro-missile launcher, an assault knife, and more.

library.rt_080:r_39407b6f8414ab98.text:
The long-range sniper unit of the VF-25 Messiah series. Its Fighter mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, atmospheric-use specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$ミシェル$$ pilots this unit.
Its dedicated sniper rifle can be used even in this configuration, but it must transform to Battroid mode for precision fire.

library.rt_080:r_477f2589dc5189f7.text:
The long-range sniper unit of the VF-25 Messiah series. Its Battroid mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, atmospheric-use specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$ミシェル$$ pilots this unit.
Its head main camera is a monocular type built for long-range shooting. Combined with the Sniper Pack and the gunner kit integrated into its EX-Gear, it is capable of highly precise sniping.

library.rt_080:r_279be1d3d0dfd9f4.text:
